      properties:
        type:

          maximum: 600

          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true

          title: Timestamp

          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'

          items:

        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors

      type: object
      properties:
        message:

          type: string

      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The optional honorific title of the pet owner, one of MR, MRS, MS or
            DR. When present it is combined with the last name to compose the owner's
            salutation. Stored and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          example: DR
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner. Accepted on input for backward
            compatibility, and always returned as the composed, normalized address. When the
            structured fields are supplied the returned value is the normalized addressLine1,
            with a single space and the normalized addressLine2 appended when addressLine2 is
            present. Optional on input as long as a non-blank addressLine1 is supplied instead.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        addressLine1:
          title: Address line 1
          description: The first line of the pet owner's structured postal address. Preferred
            over the flat 'address' when present. Normalized like 'address' (upper-cased,
            whitespace collapsed, common street-type abbreviations expanded). A non-blank value
            satisfies the owner's address requirement in place of the flat 'address'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '10 King St'
        addressLine2:
          title: Address line 2
          description: The optional second line of the pet owner's structured postal address
            (for example a unit or apartment). Normalized like 'address' when present and, when
            present, appended to the composed 'address' after a single space.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'Unit 4'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: The telephone number of the pet owner. The value is normalized to
            E.164 form. Spaces, dashes and brackets are stripped. A leading '+' and country
            code are kept when present, otherwise country code '+61' is assumed and a single
            leading '0' is dropped from the national digits. The result must be a '+'
            followed by 8 to 15 digits. For example '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          pattern: '^[-0-9()+.\s]*$'
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: The email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a
            syntactically valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased.
          type: string
          format: email
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: george.franklin@example.com
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: The owner's 4-digit postcode. Optional. When present it must be valid
            for the owner's city per the fixed region ranges (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099,
            QLD 4000-4099); a city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode. Stored
            and returned when supplied.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          example: '2000'
        registrationDate:
          title: Registration date
          description: The date the pet owner was registered. When omitted on create it
            defaults to the server's current date. Returned in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '2020-06-15'
        birthDate:
          title: Birth date
          description: The pet owner's date of birth. Optional. When present it is used to
            derive the owner's ageBand against the registrationDate. Accepted and returned
            in ISO 'YYYY-MM-DD' format.
          type: string
          format: date
          example: '1990-01-01'

          title: Shares household
          description: When true, declares this owner a deliberate member of an existing
            household and bypasses the household duplicate block, allowing creation even though
            another owner already shares the same lastName and postcode (the household key).
            Otherwise such a request is rejected with 409 Conflict. A declared member is created
            and is not flagged as a possible duplicate.

          example: false

                lastName (for example 'DR Who'); just the lastName when no title was supplied.
              type: string
              example: 'DR Franklin'
              readOnly: true
            telephoneDisplay:
              title: Telephone display
              description: The stored E.164 telephone formatted for humans, as the recognized
                country code (with its leading '+'), a space, then the national digits grouped
                in threes from the left and separated by spaces. For example the stored
                '+61412345678' is returned as '+61 412 345 678'. The raw 'telephone' stays in
                E.164 form.

                first three letters of lastName and NNNN is a per-city 4-digit zero-padded sequence

                city.

                whitespace) joined to the postcode by '|', so any two owners sharing a lastName and
                postcode automatically receive the same value. Absent for owners without a postcode,
                which belong to no shared household.
              type: string
              example: '3F2A1B0C9D8E'
              readOnly: true
            identityKey:

                '<telephone>|<email>|<householdId>' where telephone is the normalized E.164
                telephone, email is the lower-cased email (empty when the owner has no email)

              type: string

            membershipPoints:

            membershipLevel:

              maximum: 4
              example: 2
              readOnly: true
            locality:

              example: 'NSW'
              readOnly: true
            timezone:

              readOnly: true
            ageBand:

## What I changed

The stored `registrationDate` is already business-day-adjusted by the controller, so all three fiscal-year–derived values compute off it. I moved them to a fiscal year that starts on **1 July** (Australian convention — July–Dec belongs to the *next* calendar year's FY; e.g. 2025-08-01 and 2026-03-01 both → FY26).

**`Owner.java`**
- Added `fiscalYearOf(LocalDate)` — the single date→fiscal-year mapping: `month >= 7 ? year + 1 : year`.
- Added `getFiscalYear()` returning `FY<YY>` (last two digits of the fiscal year), or `null` when there's no registration date.
- `getMembershipNumber()` now uses the fiscal-year `YY` for the identifier's year segment instead of `registrationDate.getYear() % 100`.
- `hasLongTenure(...)` now counts **elapsed fiscal years** (`fiscalYearOf(asOf) - fiscalYearOf(registrationDate) > 1`) instead of a 365-day window; a newly created owner still has zero tenure, so tenure points are never awarded on creation.
- Removed the now-unused `ChronoUnit` import and updated the membership-points doc.

**`openapi.yml`** (source for the generated `OwnerDto`; MapStruct auto-maps the matching getters)
- Added the read-only `fiscalYear` field.
- Updated `membershipNumber` and `membershipPoints` descriptions to the fiscal-year basis.

The acceptance test (`fiscalYear` matches `FY\d{2}`) passes, and I verified the behaviour change in the audit log: an owner registered 2026-09-10 now gets `membershipNumber=…-M27` (FY27), whereas the old calendar-year rule would have produced `-M26`.
